corrected_content.problem: What is $(\sin x - \cos x)^{2} + (\sin x + \cos x)^{2}$?
corrected_content.worked_solution: Expand the two squares. Their mixed terms cancel, so $$(\sin x-\cos x)^2+(\sin x+\cos x)^2=2\sin^2 x+2\cos^2 x=2.$$
